description: Search paid x402 APIs and datasets by need. Ranked: verified first, then probe score, then price. Each result carries what you choose on: status, score (0..1), evidence_tier, paid_verified (we bought it with real USDC and it delivered), has_sample (a cheap preview exists), price. Relevance comes from the query text; a specific need in plain words matches best. Zero results means nothing listed matches. Results are dated evidence, not guarantees. Returns a summary per listing; detail='full' returns every field. Free, read-only.

category.description: Optional filter: one of the most-populated categories. Omit if none fits; query text still finds long-tail ones.

detail.description: summary (default) or full: every field per listing.

max_price.description: Max price per call. Omit for no cap.

mpp_method.description: Only listings offering this MPP method, e.g. stripe, tempo, evm.

protocol.description: Only listings offering this payment protocol. Omit for any.

query.description: What you need, specifically: data, freshness, format, constraint. Drives relevance.

name: find_paid_service
title: Find a paid service
